controls.title: Require short-lived CI/CD federation and prohibit stored service-account keys
controls.requirement: CI/CD cloud authentication must use short-lived federation and the governed Google Cloud hierarchy must prohibit user-managed service-account key creation and upload.

validation.pending_reason: Workload Identity Federation token exchange, effective organization policy, and live service-account-key inventory require the pending v0.7 Google Cloud bootstrap.

controls.title: Use dedicated least-privilege runtime identities
controls.requirement: Each deployed Cloud Run workload must execute as a dedicated runtime service account that is distinct from CI plan and apply identities.

validation.pending_reason: The runtime service-account binding has not yet been inspected on a live Cloud Run revision.

controls.title: Keep production databases off public endpoints
controls.requirement: Production Cloud SQL instances and restricted data services must not expose public network endpoints.

validation.pending_reason: Public connectivity denial and live asset endpoint inventory require a deployed Cloud SQL instance.

controls.title: Route public traffic through the approved HTTPS edge
controls.requirement: Public application traffic must terminate through the approved regional HTTPS load-balancing, TLS, Cloud Armor, and managed DNS edge rather than directly at the workload origin.

validation.pending_reason: DNS delegation, certificate issuance, Cloud Armor behavior, origin-bypass denial, and HTTPS routing remain live v0.7 validation work.

controls.title: Keep cryptographic keys country and environment scoped
controls.requirement: Production cryptographic keys and their IAM scopes must remain country and environment specific rather than creating unrestricted cross-country key use.

validation.pending_reason: Cross-country encrypt/decrypt denial and effective KMS IAM require live keys and workload identities.

controls.title: Require reviewed cryptographic-key rotation
controls.requirement: Managed production cryptographic keys must carry an explicit rotation policy and destruction delay consistent with the reviewed data-protection design.

validation.pending_reason: A real key rotation and dependent-service continuity test has not yet been executed.

controls.title: Keep runtime secrets out of images and Terraform state
controls.requirement: Runtime secret payloads must remain in Secret Manager and must not be embedded in source, container images, Terraform configuration, or Terraform-managed secret versions.

validation.pending_reason: Live Secret Manager access, runtime injection, and Terraform state inspection remain deployment-validation requirements.

controls.title: Require reviewed pull requests and a fail-closed security verdict
controls.requirement: Changes to the protected main branch must flow through pull requests and satisfy the fail-closed Security gate verdict before merge.

controls.title: Pin workflow and build dependencies to reviewed immutable versions
controls.requirement: External GitHub Actions, container base images, and Terraform provider selections used by the reviewed build path must be bound to immutable reviewed versions or digests.

controls.title: Detect public exposure, excessive IAM, and service-account key risk
controls.requirement: Posture evaluation must identify public data exposure, prohibited public IAM, primitive or excessive privileged access, and user-managed service-account key risk.

validation.pending_reason: Current checks evaluate repository/IaC state; effective live IAM, public exposure, and service-account-key inventory require CAI/SCC after deployment.

controls.title: Report and enforce approved deployment locations
controls.requirement: Production resources that hold or process country-scoped data must remain within reviewed locations and must not silently create cross-border data movement.

validation.pending_reason: The repository defines country-aware regions, but effective location policy and live asset-location queries have not yet been exercised in Google Cloud.

controls.title: Detect manual infrastructure drift and restore reviewed state
controls.requirement: Manual or out-of-band changes to governed infrastructure must be detected, attributed, and reconciled through reviewed Terraform rather than accepted silently.

validation.pending_reason: A real out-of-band Google Cloud change and subsequent Terraform reconciliation cannot be tested before v0.7 is deployed.

controls.title: Maintain an owner- and country-aware cloud asset inventory
controls.requirement: Cloud assets must be queryable with ownership, country, environment, service, and data-classification context so ownerless, unlabelled, public, and cross-boundary resources can be identified.

validation.pending_reason: The metadata contract exists in Terraform, but a live Cloud Asset Inventory dataset does not yet exist.

controls.title: Track posture findings through owned remediation or approved exception
controls.requirement: Every material posture finding must have severity, owner, due date, status, linked exception when applicable, and closure evidence rather than remaining an unowned scanner result.

validation.pending_reason: A live cloud finding lifecycle from discovery through remediation and closure has not yet been exercised.

controls.title: Require resource ownership and classification metadata
controls.requirement: Governed projects and resources must carry reviewed naming and metadata that identifies ownership, environment, country, service, cost context, and data classification where applicable.

validation.pending_reason: The metadata input contract is statically validated; ownerless/unlabelled live assets require Cloud Asset Inventory.

controls.title: Restrict production deployment to approved identities and workflows
controls.requirement: Production deployment must be restricted to the approved repository, reviewed workflow, protected main branch, protected production environment, and dedicated short-lived deployment identities.

validation.pending_reason: The trust path is statically constrained, but WIF token exchange, environment approval, and exact Google Cloud IAM have not been live-validated.

controls.title: Govern security exceptions with ownership, approval, compensation, and expiry
controls.requirement: Security exceptions must be explicit, independently approved, time bounded, tracked, and supported by compensating controls; expired exceptions must fail validation.

controls.title: Centralize security-relevant cloud telemetry
controls.requirement: Selected application, IAM, KMS, load-balancer, deployment, and audit telemetry must route to governed logging destinations with country-aware operational boundaries and security visibility.

validation.pending_reason: Log delivery, retention, sink-writer IAM, country isolation, and queryability require live observability resources.
